description.narrative: AMEA aims for systems change in the delivery of business development services for farmer organizations and Agri-SMEs. AMEA works towards inclusive and sustainable growth by improving and better coordinating the business development services for Farmer Organizations and Agri-SMEs which in turn create added value for farmers.

AMEA is an alliance of agencies working towards the professionalization of Farmer Organizations (FOs). This is to be done through the pursuit of global standardization to be achieved through coordinated business service delivery using standardized, peer-reviewed assessment tools and curriculum delivered by certified trainers, coaches, and mentors; facilitation for access to affordable finance and promoting the use of agricultural technology. Agricultural Leadership Programme Developed by IFC -World Bank is one such curriculum. Currently, Cordaid is the host and network facilitator of the AMEA Kenya local network comprising 11 organisations.
The target group for AMEA are local network organizations, smallholder farmers and Agri-SMEs.
